sections.title: Hosting
paragraphs: This site is hosted by [Netlify](netlify): Netlify, Inc., 101 2nd Street, San Francisco, CA 94105, United States, [privacy@netlify.com](netlifyContact). Like any host, Netlify receives your IP address and the headers of your requests in order to serve the pages; it does not publish how long it keeps them. Its servers may be outside the European Union: Netlify takes part in the EU–US Data Privacy Framework and also uses the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.
paragraphsFr: Ce site est hébergé par [Netlify](netlify) : Netlify, Inc., 101 2nd Street, San Francisco, CA 94105, États-Unis, [privacy@netlify.com](netlifyContact). Comme tout hébergeur, Netlify reçoit votre adresse IP et les en-têtes de vos requêtes pour servir les pages ; il ne publie pas combien de temps il les garde. Ses serveurs peuvent se trouver hors de l'Union européenne : Netlify adhère au Data Privacy Framework UE–États-Unis et recourt aussi aux clauses contractuelles types de la Commission européenne.
